title: Email entry has no persistent or programmatic label
evidence: Fresh isolated IAB tab: email text field was unnamed in AX tree; read-only DOM inspection found no label and no aria-label.
why: A screen-reader user reaches an unnamed field; the placeholder is also the only visible email cue and disappears during entry.
remedy: Give the field a persistent Email label associated through for/id; preserve the existing code-only auth behavior.

title: Home occasion panel uses page ink on an inverted panel
why: The dark capture has nearly white heading on pale panel; the light capture reverses into dark text on dark panel. The opportunity cannot be read reliably.
remedy: Render this prose on its page ground, or use the existing paired panel ink for every text role. Keep the ordinary action on act under D359.
corroboration: The occasion panel background uses panel, but heading uses ink and body mut. Dark heading #F1F4EF on #E9ECE3 is1.077:1; Light heading #151B17 on #141A16 is1.010:1. Body is2.108:1 dark and2.674:1 light. Both-theme captures visibly lose the title. This is a real token-role mismatch; correct inverse ink or rethink the container within canon. Home lead fixture limits do not explain this static CSS failure.

title: Generic sheet leaves keyboard focus behind the visible task
why: Recorded opening leaves focus on hdrSearch outside the sheet; seven subsequent Tab targets remain outside before Close. Source has no initial focus, trap, background inertness, or restoration. Book uses a real dialog and must not inherit this finding.
remedy: Give the shared sheet host an explicit focus lifecycle and background isolation, preserving its existing sheet geometry and nested-sheet behavior.
verification: verified source and recorded keyboard trace

title: Legal leaves the shared paper and action palette
why: Legal switches to cool white/gray cards and gold or orange ordinary navigation while Get and Support retain the shared warm paper/green-black system. Reading remains clear, but the transition looks like a different product.
remedy: Use existing ground/ink/act tokens for the standalone document shell, retaining its prose layout and all legal text.
corroboration: #9A7B18 on page #EFF2EE is3.564:1; on white panels4.023:1. These normal-sized links require4.5:1. Legal also retains old palette/OS default; get/support use canonical dark-first palette. Preserve legal wording.

title: Autumn Light action text is below AA
why: Technical-audit source evidence: Autumn Light accent becomes act; ordinary17pt semibold button ink on it is4.312:1. Canon does not waive contrast. No native detector or capture claim.
remedy: Resolve action ink/paint in the token system for this pair; verify every look in both appearances, including pressed and busy states.

title: Whole course-card row geometry conflicts with AX3 and compact width
why: Technical-audit source evidence:20pt fixed rows hold scaling type; ordinary-size9-hole content plus leaf padding needs382pt before page gutters. No safe full-grid capture available to B; do not score unobserved rendering.
remedy: Let row height follow measured text; choose a horizontal grid or fit strategy from available width at all type sizes, with pinned row labels.
verification: source arithmetic only; not rendered in inspected captures

title: AX3 live-round context displaces the scoring controls
why: On SE3 AX3, course/tee/rating, setup, sync status, hole header and the stacked score legend fill almost the entire screen before the first golfer; the first plus/minus controls require a scroll.
remedy: At accessibility sizes place the current hole and current golfer controls before secondary course/tee metadata and strip legend, or disclose those secondary details. Preserve full text scaling and truthful sync status.

title: Filled tee details lose their visible individual labels
why: The setup displays a tee word followed by two bare numbers. AX3 stacks them into separate rows, but the collective Tee & rating heading still does not identify the slope value. Accessibility labels exist in source; this finding is visual recognition.
remedy: Keep compact visible Tee, Rating and Slope labels associated with the filled fields, especially in the AX3 stacked form.

title: First-round composer spends most of its length explaining league math
why: A brand-new golfer has no league, yet the screen continues from an empty score into a league-points panel and all five point bands. The core course/score task competes with explanation that does not yet apply to their competition.
remedy: For the no-league first-round state, keep the course/score task and a short consequence sentence visible; disclose the existing point-band explanation from a named help control. Do not change scoring.

title: Empty profile repeats the absence of a record
why: The credential shows zero rounds, then an empty trophy case, four empty statistics, another no-rounds section and an empty courses section. The golfer must pass several statements of absence before the next useful action.
remedy: Keep the identity card and one first-round next step; reveal the record sections as data arrives, using the existing record grammar and without removing access to relevant actions.

title: Book status letters merge visually into point totals
why: Cells read as 33D, 22D or 16*D at the same typographic scale. The key explaining Dropped appears below the table, out of the narrow first viewport. A first-time reader must decode what is points and what is a status.
remedy: Give the existing status marker visual separation and a smaller record role; place a compact legend next to the display selector or provide the status in the cell accessible name. Preserve the exact Book semantics and receipt path.

title: Compete empty state repeats its primary invitation
why: Start something appears beside the title and again beneath the empty story. Two equal invitations dilute the one useful decision on a screen with little content.
remedy: Keep the primary Start something at the empty-state action group and let the farther title action go quiet for this state, following one fact, one place.

title: The web round-share artifact repeats its performance band
why: The central band label and immediately following sentence both say the golfer played to their handicap. The repetition takes space from the course/date facts and makes the share artifact more explanatory than memorable.
remedy: Use one existing named-band sentence for this branch of the share renderer, preserving all factual public fields and the approved pennant.

title: Small functional labels and help controls need local accessibility repair
why: Composer gross/HCP labels are10px; record semantics are legitimate but size and dim ink remain weak. Wizard .ibtn has18×18px target with dim on bg2 about2.28:1; target needs local44px hit region and visible ink. Only first wizard step captured; later-step hitbox is source evidence, not tested interaction.
remedy: Keep the small visual glyph if desired but give it an honest44px hit region and readable token ink without colliding with its label.
verification: source verified; composer label capture corroborated; later wizard steps not captured

title: Compact calendar columns are narrower than44pt
why: At375pt, 40 outer +24 inner padding +24 total column gaps yields41pt day width. minHeight44 does not fix width. This is a guidance gap, not a recorded mistap.
remedy: Reclaim horizontal spacing or provide a compact date-selection arrangement whose actual hit bounds meet 44pt.
verification: source arithmetic only; no safe rendered schedule

title: Album read failure is shown as empty
why: Technical-audit source evidence: catch enters .empty, offering no truthful failure/retry. Missing fixture means no visual score.
remedy: Add a truthful failed state with retry and preserve already loaded items during a refresh failure.

title: Spacing-token adoption is still a large ratcheted debt
evidence: Fresh exact LINT-06 extraction:332 native +844 index.html =1,176 off-scale spacing values. The current baseline is1,193; ROAD_TO_TEN reported1,206. This rule counts disallowed numeric values per source line, not all literal spacing, and excludes generated/test directories according to the repository extractor. Report data is in cup-ten-spacing.json.
why: Repeated local spacing decisions keep repairs from propagating consistently and make each responsive adjustment expensive; counts alone do not prove1,176 visible defects.
remedy: Pay down literals by touched shared components and measured surface repairs; do not replace every number mechanically or conflate drawing geometry with spacing.
verification: source count, not visible defect count

title: Ordinary actions retain a colored blurred shadow
why: Primary .btn uses0 8px22px -12px colored act shadow. No-glow rule is explicit; do not remove legitimate zero-blur selection marks merely to clear detector.
remedy: Remove colored blurred ordinary-action shadow; keep legitimate zero-blur selection marks.
